summary: Verified fix for non-admin action-permission gating (gagan 'Admin only.' bug) using qaprice (role=user) and qaadmin. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass (create/rename/bill-toggle/item price/category discount/delink/clone/delete as qaprice; after revoking add/edit/delete:priceLists via PATCH /users/{id}/permissions all mutating endpoints return 403 while GET stays 200; perms restored). Frontend: qaprice sees Customer Price Lists page (no 'Admin only.'), New price list, Edit name, Clone, Bill-required switch, Delete (only when delete:priceLists granted - hidden when revoked, verified both states), detail page Upload Excel + De-link, item price (77) and category discount saved & persisted; delete via confirm dialog works. Vendor price lists page loads for qaprice with New vendor price list visible and list-delete hidden. Products: New Product + Add SKU visible; Customers: Download template / Import Excel / New Customer visible. qaadmin still sees all buttons on all these pages. All QA price lists cleaned up.

minor.issue: Clone does not copy bill_amount_required from source list (new list defaults to required).

ui_bugs.issue: Per-item delete buttons and editable name/unit/price inputs are shown to users WITHOUT edit:/delete:vendorPriceLists (qaprice saw 56 delete buttons). Clicking would hit backend 403. Same class of bug the user reported - gate with canAct('delete:vendorPriceLists') / canAct('edit:vendorPriceLists'); 'Add item' + 'Upload Excel' correctly need add:.
Item price inputs and discount save buttons are not gated by canEdit; a user with priceLists nav but no edit:priceLists will see editable fields and get 403 toasts.

'New Order' (topbar-new-order) and Dashboard '+ Create Order' shown to users without newOrder/orders/add:orders (qaprice); clicking silently redirects back to Dashboard. Hide when !can('newOrder') && !can('orders').

action_items: Gate VendorPriceLists item-row delete/edit controls with canAct('delete:vendorPriceLists') / canAct('edit:vendorPriceLists')
Hide topbar 'New Order' and dashboard 'Create Order' for users lacking order permissions
Optional: copy bill_amount_required on price-list clone
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~9.9k lines - should be split into routers

During testing an actor with username 'admin' (not this agent) removed delete:priceLists from qaprice at 12:18:51 UTC (see /api/users/{id}/permissions/audit); restored by tester to the requested set. If unexpected, investigate who is using the 'admin' account concurrently.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (3 minor gating gaps found outside requested scope)
